Title / Headline: Building Machine-Payable APIs: Introducing x402 Web Scraper on Base
Content / Copy:
AI agents need clean web data, but traditional subscriptions create friction. Introducing x402 Scraper API—a web extraction service built around the HTTP 402 Payment Required status code.

### How It Works
1. Send POST request to API endpoint.
2. Receive 402 Payment Required with payment requirements (0.005 USDC on Base).
3. Settle transaction on-chain and retry request with transaction proof header.

Built with Node.js, Express, and x402-express on Base.
